results.description:
The billionaire tearing down my mother's favourite building just hired me for thirty days. To keep me quiet.

I should explain the building. My mother left when I was fourteen. No note, no birthday call, no Thanksgiving. What she left behind was a book of glossy London photographs and a house full of lawyers who fish. My dad. My two brothers. People I love who have never once understood me.

So I came to the city in her book. Forty thousand followers, a flat the size of a closet, and a landmark I went viral trying to save.

The man demolishing it is Cormack Hart, heir to a family that makes mine look like a greeting card. His sister wants to be my friend. His assistant warns me who to watch.

I've never fit anywhere. Not in Indiana. Not in this office. Not in this city I've dreamed about since I was a kid.

And the first person to make me feel like I belong is the one man I'm supposed to be fighting.

Perfect for fans of Emily Henry, Tessa Bailey, and Lauren Asher, THE LONDON MAN is a sizzling, emotional, slow-burn-to-scorching romance about ambition, family, and the unexpected love that changes everything.
